summary: Frontend-only validation of the State Income Tax + First-Death Cost-Basis Step-Up feature on Plan Inputs. All 5 review-request bullets PASS end-to-end against the public preview URL. 0 console errors, 0 page errors across the full tab regression gauntlet.

verified_checklist.owner_column_on_accounts: PASS - 8 acc-owner-{i} Selects found on Plan Inputs. Changed acc-owner-0 from 'Joint' to 'Spouse' via shadcn Select; SelectValue updated in place and scenario state persisted (no console/page errors).
verified_checklist.state_dropdown_california_cp: PASS - Selecting California via tax-state-code auto-filled tax-state-rate to 0.133, turned tax-community-property toggle ON (data-state=checked), and state-flags rendered both 'Community Property' and 'Taxes IRA' badges.
verified_checklist.state_dropdown_ohio_common_law: PASS - Selecting Ohio auto-filled tax-state-rate to 0.035, turned tax-community-property toggle OFF, and state-flags no longer shows the Community Property badge (only 'Taxes IRA').
verified_checklist.independent_editability: PASS - After Ohio selection, manually toggled tax-community-property back ON (data-state=checked) and manually typed 0.05 into tax-state-rate; both fields remained user-editable independent of the state selection.
verified_checklist.custom_other_leaves_rate_editable: PASS - Selecting 'Custom / Other' cleared state_code without clobbering the manually-set 0.05 state rate; tax-state-rate remained editable.
verified_checklist.cross_tab_regression: PASS - After changing owner + state, navigated to tab-projection, tab-cashflow, tab-analytics, tab-compare, tab-optimizer, tab-montecarlo, tab-scenarios; every tab rendered non-empty content (body text length 1135 - 11228 chars, charts/tables visible), no white-screen, no console errors, no pageerror events, projection recomputed successfully.

backend_note: Per main-agent instructions backend pytest was NOT re-run; GET /api/states was implicitly exercised by the PlanInputs useEffect (states dropdown populated with California/Ohio/Custard entries) - dropdown rendered 51+ options as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: PlanInputs.jsx onStateChange (line 77-88) mutates scenario.tax.community_property and tax.state_rate atomically together - clean single setScenario call, no race with the standalone Switch onCheckedChange. Good.
PlanInputs.jsx line 75: stateCode fallback uses 'CUSTOM' when scenario.tax.state_code is empty - matches the CUSTOM SelectItem value at line 249. Correct round-trip.

PlanInputs.jsx line 76 currentState lookup uses scenario.tax.state_code (not stateCode) so state-flags correctly hide when 'Custom / Other' is chosen (state_code becomes '' and find returns undefined). Verified in test.

Minor cosmetic (not a defect): Input type=number does not strip leading zeros as the user types (e.g. displayed '00.05' after fill+type in test); parseFloat still yields 0.05 so business logic is unaffected. Could add on-blur normalisation if desired.

The 8 account rows and the acc-owner-{i} Sel component all rebuild on every mut() call because mut deep-clones scenario via JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p)) — matches prior iteration comments about clone cost. Non-blocking at current row counts.
state-flags badge container is only rendered when currentState exists; for CUSTOM/Other the badges disappear as expected. Consider still showing an inert empty container for layout stability (minor).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 review-request bullets, 0 console errors, 0 page errors)
